Resolves #20642

A Playwright run and the dev server now refuse an install that differs from `package-lock.json`, and name each drifted package and the fix. `buildScripts/util/check-installed-dependencies.mjs` compares the lockfile with npm's own install record, `node_modules/.package-lock.json`, by `version` and `resolved`. The eight Playwright configs call `assertInstallMatchesLock()` at load, so `npx playwright test -c …` stops before a worker starts. `npm run server-start` runs the CLI first (`preserver-start`). Linked packages, and absent optional, `devOptional` or peer packages, are not drift. `findInstallDrift` is exported for Fleet's seat Start, which Grace will key on it after the 13.4 cut.

Evidence: L3 (local: a real off-lock install made by npm, refused by a Playwright run and by the dev server; green across all eight configs on the matching install) → L3 required (the ticket's four ACs). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/checkInstalledDependencies.spec.mjs`, 6 tests (match; version and `resolved` drift; missing required; skipped link, optional, `devOptional` and peer; the assert's message and missing record; the CLI's exit codes). |
| AC-2 | After `npm i @playwright/test@1.64.1 --no-save`, `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs --list` exits 1, naming `@playwright/test`, `playwright` and `playwright-core` (1.64.1 installed, the lock wants 1.65.0). After `npm i` it lists 6693 tests in 618 files. |
| AC-3 | On the same off-lock install, `npm run server-start` exits 1 from `preserver-start`, and no dev server process starts. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: every tier loads these configs after `npm ci`; its caches hold only `~/.cache/ms-playwright`. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The module checks the repository it lives in by default, because Playwright never changes directory and `process.cwd()` is wherever the command was typed. `playwright.config.unit-tz.mjs` checks twice, since it also imports the unit config; that costs milliseconds, which is less than a special case. No install hook, per Grace's ruling on #1480's surface.

## Test Evidence
- **Refusal on a real stale install:** `npm i @playwright/test@1.64.1 --no-save` left `package.json` and `package-lock.json` untouched. Both entry points exited 1 with the same three-package message; `npm i` changed those 3 packages back, and the check then exits 0.
- **Green on the matching install:** unit (the new spec plus `list/`) 104/104, component `NavigatorEventSource` 1/1, e2e `NewsTabOverflow` 3/3. `unit-tz`, `matrix`, `visual`, the base config and `update-chain` load and list.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the commit hooks ran, including `check-guard-ci-parity` on `package.json`.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] Peers on a stale clone get the refusal at their next run instead of a quiet different reality; how often it fires decides whether an install hook is ever worth it (Grace, #1480).
